name: Troy Dale Jackson
summary: Troy Dale Jackson (born June 26, 1968) is an American politician and former logger who is a United States senator-elect from Maine. A member of the Democratic Party, he served in the Maine Senate from 2008 to 2014 and from 2016 to 2024, representing parts of northern Aroostook County. He was the Senate president from 2018 to 2024.
